latin: Necessarium est dicere secundum Auenroem quod substantia est de intrinseca quiditate accidentis, et est opinio et Aristoteli et philosophiae maxime consona.
translation: It is necessary to say, following Averroes, that substance belongs to the intrinsic quiddity of an accident, and this is an opinion in the fullest harmony with both Aristotle and philosophy.
translation_note: 'quiditas' (farmer1998:19670) kept as the technical term quiddity.
